scope.description: A named-company deep dossier for the already-published North Vector Dynamics record. The qualified lead is an additive organization refresh: it closes concrete portfolio, current-specification, government-research, investor, and integration gaps without creating a duplicate organization or asserting operational adoption.

source.title: About North Vector Dynamics
source.locator: About, company scope, Calgary location, and public contact sections
source.summary: North Vector's current official company profile identifies a Calgary, Canadian-owned and controlled defence technology company working in precision interception, autonomy, and advanced propulsion, with a public portfolio spanning counter-UAS and hypersonic work.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official product pages, Government of Canada grant record, investor portfolio, independent contract reporting, and independent partner-integration reporting
followUpQuestions: Confirm the current published CM-70 specifications against the dated Janes variation before publication; use the current official product page for proposed figures.
Confirm that CI-60 counter-UAS, CI-60 Target, and SHIELD are sufficiently distinct product records and do not duplicate any unpublished capability.
Review the DRDC work as research activity and the MIL-V relationship as prototype integration, not procurement, operational adoption, or customer status.
Keep the Tech Horizons and CSG financing discovery trail out of canonical fields until an investor or company durable source is recovered.
reviewWarnings: The current CM-70 product page lists 3 kg, 0.9 m, 3.5 km and 900 km/h, while a dated May 2026 Janes article reports earlier 2 kg, 0.72 m and greater-than-1,000 km/h figures. The candidate treats the official page as current and records the variation for review.
Tech Horizons and CSG financing appears in secondary and LinkedIn discovery, but no durable company or investor source was recovered in this run; no financing operation is proposed.
ARCTOS is marked coming soon on the official site and has no concrete public specifications, so it remains a deferred product-watch item rather than a canonical capability.
The Convergence MIL-V evidence documents partner prototype integration only; it does not establish a Canadian Armed Forces procurement, contract, or operational deployment.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Reviewed the current company identity, Canadian presence, bounded portfolio statement, and public contact routes.
Reviewed official CM-70, CI-60 counter-UAS, CI-60 Target, and SHIELD product pages for concrete specifications, features, applications, and whether each warrants a distinct capability.
Verified the existing IDEaS contribution, legal name, operating-name alias, amount, dates, and concept-development boundary through the Government of Canada grant record.
Verified the ONE9 portfolio relationship through the investor's current portfolio page and resolved the historic company announcement to durable company and investor sources.
Recovered independent reporting on the DRDC hypersonic-propulsion contract and its research scope.
Ran English and French queries, including French counter-UAS terms; the official parliamentary record confirmed no additional proposed field beyond the core product and R&D boundary.
Patent and intellectual-property searches did not return an attributable public filing that could safely support a field; ARCTOS was separately recorded as coming soon rather than added.

leads.refreshSummary: North Vector Dynamics is already published, but its record currently contains only the CM-70 and an IDEaS contribution relationship. Current official product pages support an in-place CM-70 specification refresh plus distinct CI-60 counter-UAS, CI-60 Target, and SHIELD records. Government, company, investor, and independent sources support a bounded DRDC research-contract program, ONE9 founding-investor relationship, and Convergence MIL-V prototype-integration relationship.
intendedChanges: Refresh the existing CM-70 capability without changing its ID or slug.
Add distinct CI-60 counter-UAS, CI-60 Target, and SHIELD capability records.
Add a bounded DRDC hypersonic-propulsion research-contract program.
Add ONE9 founding-investor and Convergence MIL-V prototype-integration relationships.
Enrich profile metadata with current portfolio, public contact, and evidence-boundary context.
